data.summary:
This **FORTIFICATION** follows these rules:

- when it is set up, every part of it must be up to 1" from another of its parts
- **ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY** models of yours can be set up on, or end any kind of move on, its floor sections
- each **ADEPTA SORORITAS** unit of yours that is up to 1" from it can perform an extra Act of Faith in each phase
